description: 关键词大小写 K-b 的诊断兼容层回归夹具：变异自 aster-lang-test tier1 语料的错误源码（en-US），首条诊断所在行含 K-b 的关键词（be、set、to、not、and、or、for、function、map、async），ParseDiagnostics 给出的全部诊断（码、行、列、参数），期望值取自 K-b 之前的 core（aster-lang-core f995b84）。K-b 只放宽关键词位置，这些错误源码的诊断与错误恢复必须逐条相同。

cases.source:
# ========================================
# HIPAA Compliance Demo: PHI Validation & Access Control
# §164.312 - Access Control & Audit Controls
# ========================================

Module examples.compliance.hipaa_validation_demo.

# HIPAA 访问控制级别（服务端定义，不可客户端伪造）
Define AccessLevel has
  level_name,
  can_view_demographics,
  can_view_medical,
  can_view_financial,
  can_modify.

# PHI 数据分类
Define PHICategory has
  category,
  sensitivity,
  requires_consent,
  retention_years.

# 访问请求
Define PHIAccessRequest has
  user_id,
  user_role,
  phi_category_name,
  purpose,
  has_consent.

# HIPAA 验证结果
Define HIPAAValidation has
  is_compliant,
  passed_count,
  failed_count,
  message.

# 定义访问级别（服务端权威函数）
Rule get_access_level given role, produce:
  If role equals to "physician"
    Return AccessLevel with level_name set to "FULL", can_view_demographics set to true, can_view_medical set to true, can_view_financial set to false, can_modify set to true.
  If role equals to "nurse"
    Return AccessLevel with level_name set to "CLINICAL", can_view_demographics set to true, can_view_medical set to true, can_view_financial set to false, can_modify set to false.
  If role equals to "billing"
    Return AccessLevel with level_name set to "BILLING", can_view_demographics set to true, can_view_medical set to false, can_view_financial set to true, can_modify set to false.
  If role equals to "admin"
    Return AccessLevel with level_name set to "ADMIN", can_view_demographics set to true, can_view_medical set to false, can_view_financial set to false, can_modify set to false.
  Return AccessLevel with level_name set to "NONE", can_view_demographics set to false, can_view_medical set to false, can_view_financial set to false, can_modify set to false.

# 定义 PHI 类别
Rule get_phi_category given category_name, produce:
  If category_name equals to "demographics"
    Return PHICategory with category set to "DEMOGRAPHICS", sensitivity set to "L2", requires_consent set to false, retention_years set to 6.
  If category_name equals to "medical"
    Return PHICategory with category set to "MEDICAL", sensitivity set to "L3", requires_consent set to true, retention_years set to 10.
  If category_name equals to "financial"
    Return PHICategory with category set to "FINANCIAL", sensitivity set to "L2", requires_consent set to false, retention_years set to 7.
  If category_name equals to "psychotherapy"
    Return PHICategory with category set to "PSYCHOTHERAPY", sensitivity set to "L3", requires_consent set to true, retention_years set to 10.
  Return PHICategory with category set to "UNKNOWN", sensitivity set to "L3", requires_consent set to true, retention_years set to 10.

# HIPAA §164.312(a) - 访问控制验证
Rule validate_access_control given request, produce:
  Let level be get_access_level(request.user_role).
  Let category be get_phi_category(request.phi_category_name).
  If category.category equals to "MEDICAL"
    If level.can_view_medical equals to false
      Return err of "HIPAA: Role " plus request.user_role plus " cannot access medical records".
  If category.category equals to "FINANCIAL"
    If level.can_view_financial equals to false
      Return err of "HIPAA: Role " plus request.user_role plus " cannot access financial records".
  If category.category equals to "PSYCHOTHERAPY"
    If level.can_view_medical equals to false
      Return err of "HIPAA: Role " plus request.user_role plus " cannot access psychotherapy notes".
  Return ok of Text.concat("Access validated for role: ", request.user_role).

# HIPAA §164.508 - 同意验证
Rule validate_consent given request, produce:
  Let category be get_phi_category(request.phi_category_name).
  If category.requires_consent
    If request.has_consent equals to false
      Return err of Text.concat("HIPAA: Consent required for ", category.category).
  Return ok of "Consent validated".

# HIPAA §164.512 - 使用目的验证
Rule validate_purpose given request, produce:
  If request.purpose equals to "treatment"
    Return ok of "Purpose validated".
  If request.purpose equals to "payment"
    Return ok of "Purpose validated".
  If request.purpose equals to "healthcare_operations"
    Return ok of "Purpose validated".
  Return err of "HIPAA: Purpose " plus request.purpose plus " is not permitted".

# 完整 HIPAA 合规验证（简化版 - 仅检查访问控制）
Rule validate_hipaa_compliance given request, produce:
   access_result be validate_access_control(request).
  Let consent_result be validate_consent(request).
  Let purpose_result be validate_purpose(request).
  If Result.isOk(access_result)
    If Result.isOk(consent_result)
      If Result.isOk(purpose_result)
        Return HIPAAValidation with is_compliant set to true, passed_count set to 3, failed_count set to 0, message set to "All HIPAA checks passed".
  Return HIPAAValidation with is_compliant set to false, passed_count set to 0, failed_count set to 1, message set to "HIPAA compliance failed".

# 生成 HIPAA 合规报告
Rule generate_hipaa_report given user_id, validation, produce:
  If validation.is_compliant
    Return Text.concat("HIPAA COMPLIANCE: PASSED for ", user_id).
  Otherwise
    Return "HIPAA COMPLIANCE: FAILED for " plus user_id plus ". Failed checks: " plus validation.failed_count.

# 示例：医生访问医疗记录（合规）
Rule demo_compliant_access, produce:
  Let request be PHIAccessRequest with user_id set to "DR-001", user_role set to "physician", phi_category_name set to "medical", purpose set to "treatment", has_consent set to true.
  Return validate_hipaa_compliance(request).

# 示例：账单人员访问医疗记录（不合规）
Rule demo_non_compliant_access, produce:
  Let request be PHIAccessRequest with user_id set to "BILL-001", user_role set to "billing", phi_category_name set to "medical", purpose set to "payment", has_consent set to false.
  Return validate_hipaa_compliance(request).

# 示例：攻击者尝试伪造权限
Rule demo_spoofed_access_blocked, produce:
  Let request be PHIAccessRequest with user_id set to "ATTACKER-001", user_role set to "admin", phi_category_name set to "medical", purpose set to "curiosity", has_consent set to false.
  Return validate_hipaa_compliance(request).

cases.source:
Module test.insurance.life.

# 合成示例策略——数值取自公开权威来源（2026-08 检索），非真实保险公司费率表。
#   · 基准费率：NerdWallet（费率由 LifeStein 提供，数据截至 2026-08-01）
#     $500k/20 年期/Preferred/男性非吸烟：20 岁 $210、30 岁 $213、40 岁 $321、
#     50 岁 $810、60 岁 $2331、70 岁 $9702（年保费）
#     ★保费随年龄非线性：20→30 仅 +1.4%，40→50 +152%，60→70 +316%
#   · 吸烟倍数 3.62x：由上表实算（60 岁 8435/2331）；ValuePenguin +215%、
#     U.S.News +146%、Policygenius +217%——行业区间 2.5-4.5x，无单一权威值
#   · BMI 分档：InsuranceGeek（Preferred Plus ≤25 / Preferred 26-28 /
#     Standard Plus 29-30 / Standard 31-35 / Table Rating 36-40 / >40-42 拒保）
#     ★该表为「典型 carrier 代表性限值」，未指名具体公司，各家 build chart 差异可达数十磅
#   · 健康倍数按 **BMI 档**取值（88/100/121/177/250），★注意它**不等于**
#     LifeStein 的核保等级费率差（40 岁男 Pref+ $321 / Pref $405 / Std $631
#     = 100/126/197）——真实核保里 BMI 只是决定等级的因素之一，此处为让样本
#     可执行而把两者合并成单一维度。121/177 取自等级差 126/197 的量级但**经过
#     人为调整**以拉开与 BMI 档的对应关系，不是可直接引用的费率。
#   · 职业倍数：BLS《2024 年致命职业伤害普查》（2026-02-19 发布）
#     全国基准 3.3/10万 FTE；伐木 110.4(33.5x)、渔猎 88.8(26.9x)、屋顶 48.7(14.8x)、
#     飞行员 36.7(11.1x)、卡车司机 25.7(7.8x，绝对死亡数 950 全美最高)、建筑 15.8(4.8x)
#     ★真实核保用 flat extra（每千保额加 $2.50-5.00）而非乘数，此处简化为乘数
#   · 最高投保年龄 75：★无行业统一上限，按产品条款而定，此为示例产品设定
#   · ★期限系数（10 年 62% / 15 年 80% / 20 年 100% / 30 年 138%）：**无权威出处**。
#     检索到的费率表都以 20 年期为口径，未找到公开的跨期限系数表。
#     这四个数是为让样本覆盖期限维度而设的工程取值，仅保证单调递增，
#     不可引用为费率。若接入真实费率表，改这四个数即可，case 断言的
#     是「期限越长越贵」这个关系，不是具体百分比。

Define Applicant has applicantId, age, gender, smoker, bmi, occupation, healthScore.

Define PolicyRequest has coverageAmount, termYears, policyType.

Define LifeQuote has approved, reason, monthlyPremium, coverageAmount, termYears.

Rule calculateBaseRate given age, termYears, produce:
  Let rate be 210.
  If age at least 30
    Let rate be 213.
  If age at least 40
    Let rate be 321.
  If age at least 50
    Let rate be 810.
  If age at least 60
    Let rate be 2331.
  If age at least 70
    Let rate be 9702.
  If termYears at most 10
    Return (rate times 62) integer divided by 100.
  If termYears at most 15
    Return (rate times 80) integer divided by 100.
  If termYears at most 20
    Return rate.
  Return (rate times 138) integer divided by 100.
Rule calculateHealthMultiplier given applicant, produce:
  Let multiplier be 100.
  If applicant.bmi at least 29
    Let multiplier be 121.
  If applicant.bmi at least 31
    Let multiplier be 177.
  If applicant.bmi at least 36
    Let multiplier be 250.
  If applicant.healthScore at least 90
    If applicant.bmi less than 29
      Let multiplier be 88.
  If applicant.smoker equals to true
    Return (multiplier times 362) integer divided by 100.
  Return multiplier.
Rule calculateOccupationMultiplier given occupation, produce:
  If occupation equals to "logging"
    Return 3350.
  If occupation equals to "fishing"
    Return 2690.
  If occupation equals to "roofing"
    Return 1480.
  If occupation equals to "pilot"
    Return 1110.
  If occupation equals to "truck-driver"
    Return 780.
  If occupation equals to "construction"
    Return 480.
  If occupation equals to "office"
    Return 100.
  Return 100.
Rule calculateRiskScore given applicant, produce:
  Let score be 100.
  If applicant.smoker equals to true
    Let score be score minus 30.
  If applicant.bmi at least 31
    Let score be score minus 20.
  If applicant.bmi at least 36
    Let score be score minus 15.
  If applicant.healthScore at least 90
    Let score be score plus 10.
  If applicant.age at least 60
    Let score be score minus 15.
  Return score.
Rule generateLifeQuote given applicant, request, produce:
  If applicant.age less than 18
    Return LifeQuote with approved set to false, reason set to "Applicant below minimum issue age", monthlyPremium set to 0, coverageAmount set to 0, termYears set to 0.
  If applicant.age at least 76
    Return LifeQuote with approved set to false, reason set to "Applicant above maximum issue age", monthlyPremium set to 0, coverageAmount set to 0, termYears set to 0.
  If applicant.healthScore less than 40
    Return LifeQuote with approved set to false, reason set to "Health score below underwriting threshold", monthlyPremium set to 0, coverageAmount set to 0, termYears set to 0.
  If applicant.bmi at least 41
    Return LifeQuote with approved set to false, reason set to "Build outside underwriting limits", monthlyPremium set to 0, coverageAmount set to 0, termYears set to 0.
  If request.coverageAmount at least 5000001
    Return LifeQuote with approved set to false, reason set to "Coverage exceeds maximum", monthlyPremium set to 0, coverageAmount set to 0, termYears set to 0.
  Let baseRate be calculateBaseRate(applicant.age, request.termYears).
  Let healthMult be calculateHealthMultiplier(applicant).
  Let occMult be calculateOccupationMultiplier(applicant.occupation).
  Let scaled be (baseRate times request.coverageAmount) integer divided by 500000.
  Let withHealth be (scaled times healthMult) integer divided by 100.
  Let annual be (withHealth times occMult) integer divided by 100.
  Let monthly be annual integer divided by 12.
  Return LifeQuote with approved set to true, reason set to "Approved", monthlyPremium set to monthly, coverageAmount set to request.coverageAmount, termYears set to request.termYears.
Rule testApplicantTooYoung, produce:
  Let applicant be Applicant with applicantId set to "L1", age set to 17, gender set to "M", smoker set to false, bmi set to 22, occupation set to "office", healthScore set to 90.
  Let request be PolicyRequest with coverageAmount set to 500000, termYears set to 20, policyType set to "term".
  Let quote be generateLifeQuote(applicant, request).
  Return quote.reason.
Rule testApplicantTooOld, produce:
  Let applicant be Applicant with applicantId set to "L2", age set to 80, gender set to "M", smoker set to false, bmi set to 24, occupation set to "office", healthScore set to 80.
  Let request be PolicyRequest with coverageAmount set to 500000, termYears set to 20, policyType set to "term".
  Let quote be generateLifeQuote(applicant, request).
  Return quote.reason.
Rule testHealthScoreTooLow, produce:

  Let request be PolicyRequest with coverageAmount set to 500000, termYears set to 20, policyType set to "term".

Rule testCoverageExceedsMaximum, produce:
  Let applicant be Applicant with applicantId set to "L4", age set to 40, gender set to "M", smoker set to false, bmi set to 24, occupation set to "office", healthScore set to 85.
   request be PolicyRequest with coverageAmount set to 6000000, termYears set to 20, policyType set to "term".
  Let quote be generateLifeQuote(applicant, request).
  Return quote.reason.
Rule testYoungHealthyNonSmokerShortTerm, produce:
  Let applicant be Applicant with applicantId set to "L5", age set to 25, gender set to "M", smoker set to false, bmi set to 23, occupation set to "office", healthScore set to 85.
  Let request be PolicyRequest with coverageAmount set to 500000, termYears set to 10, policyType set to "term".
  Let quote be generateLifeQuote(applicant, request).

Rule testYoungHealthyNonSmokerLongTerm, produce:
  Let applicant be Applicant with applicantId set to "L6", age set to 30, gender set to "M", smoker set to false, bmi set to 23, occupation set to "office", healthScore set to 85.

cases.source:
Module governance.input.refs.case48.
Profile "eu-ai-act-high-risk".

Define GuardContext has amount as Decimal, tier as Text, band as Text, Meta as Map Text to Text.
Define GuardRequest has principal_roles as List of Text, action as Text, context as GuardContext.

Rule g given m as Text, produce Bool:
  Return m equals to "x".

@id("R-1")
@control("EU_AI_ACT:ART14")
Rule decide given req as GuardRequest, produce Verdict:

  Let r1 be g(b).
  Let a be Map.get(req.context.meta, "aprincipal_roles").
  Let r2 be g(a).
  If r1 and r2:
    Return Verdict.deny("x").
  Return Verdict.allow().

cases.source:
Module aster.finance.creditcard.

# 合成示例策略——数值取自公开权威来源（2026-08 检索），非真实发卡行核保政策。
#   · FICO 五档 300-579/580-669/670-739/740-799/800-850：myFICO 官网
#   · 使用率分档：Experian Q3 2024 各 FICO 档实测均值 7.1/15.2/38.6/61.4/80.7%
#     ★FICO 官方否认「30% 悬崖」——分数是连续函数。本策略的分档罚分是
#     工程简化，不代表 FICO 行为。
#   · 硬查询：myFICO（单次通常 <5 分；≥6 次破产概率达 8 倍）
#     ★只应统计 12 个月内查询（影响分数 1 年，留存报告 2 年，两者不同）
#   · APR 分档：CFPB《2025 消费信用卡市场报告》Figure 85（2024 新账户）
#     760+ 25.8% / 740-759 27.3% / ... / <620 30.0%（以基点存储避免浮点）
#   · 21 岁以下需独立还款能力或共签：Reg Z 12 CFR §1026.51(b)
#     ★§1026.51 不设任何数字门槛；36%/43% DTI 均属房贷惯例（43% 已于 2021 废止），
#     故本策略用「可支配收入」而非 DTI 比率。
#   · 担保卡押金：Discover it Secured（$200 起、1:1）、Capital One（分层 $49/$99/$200）
#   · 年费：CFPB 2024 通用卡平均 $127/年；中端 $95、高端 $550-895
#   · ★评分点值（信用分档 50/40/30/15/0、历史 35/20/10/0、使用率罚 30/22/14/6/0、
#     查询罚 20/8/3/0、就业 25/20/15/10/5/0、基础 +15）：**无权威出处**。
#     FICO 官方只公布**因子权重**（支付历史 35%/欠款 30%/账龄 15%/新开户 10%/
#     组合 10%）且明说是「人群平均、个体浮动」，不公布任何可加总的点值表；
#     真实发卡行的评分卡是专有的。这些点值是为让样本可执行而设的工程取值，
#     **相对大小**参照 FICO 权重（支付历史 35 最高、查询影响最小），
#     但绝对值不可引用。case 断言的是分档关系与边界，不是具体分数。
#   · ★担保卡触发线（分数<580 / 风险分<40）与额度上限公式（可支配收入÷2、
#     (风险分+就业分)×100）同为工程取值，无监管或行业出处。

Define ApplicantInfo has applicantId, age, annualIncome, creditScore, existingCreditCards, monthlyRent, employmentStatus, yearsAtCurrentJob.

Define FinancialHistory has bankruptcyCount, latePayments, utilization, accountAge, hardInquiries.

Define CreditCardOffer has productType, requestedLimit, hasRewards, annualFee.

Define ApprovalDecision has approved, reason, approvedLimit, interestRateAPR, monthlyFee, creditLine, requiresDeposit, depositAmount.

Define RiskScore has score, category, factors.

Define IncomeValidation has sufficient, ratio, recommendation.

Rule calculateCreditScorePoints given creditScore, produce:
  If creditScore at least 800
    Return 50.
  If creditScore at least 740
    Return 40.
  If creditScore at least 670
    Return 30.
  If creditScore at least 580
    Return 15.
  Return 0.
Rule calculateHistoryPoints given history, produce:
  If history.bankruptcyCount at least 1
    Return 0.
  If history.latePayments equals to 0
    Return 35.
  If history.latePayments at most 2
    Return 20.
  If history.latePayments at most 5
    Return 10.
  Return 0.
Rule calculateUtilizationPenalty given utilization, produce:
  If utilization at least 81
    Return 30.
  If utilization at least 61
    Return 22.
  If utilization at least 39
    Return 14.
  If utilization at least 16
    Return 6.
  Return 0.
Rule calculateInquiryPenalty given inquiries, produce:
  If inquiries at least 6
    Return 20.
  If inquiries at least 3
    Return 8.
  If inquiries at least 1
    Return 3.
  Return 0.
Rule calculateComprehensiveRiskScore given applicant, history, produce:
  Let scorePoints be calculateCreditScorePoints(applicant.creditScore).
  Let historyPoints be calculateHistoryPoints(history).
  Let utilPenalty be calculateUtilizationPenalty(history.utilization).
  Let inquiryPenalty be calculateInquiryPenalty(history.hardInquiries).
  Return ((scorePoints plus historyPoints) plus 15) minus (utilPenalty plus inquiryPenalty).
Rule assessEmploymentStability given applicant, produce:
  If applicant.employmentStatus equals to "unemployed"
    Return 0.
  If applicant.employmentStatus equals to "self-employed"
    If applicant.yearsAtCurrentJob at least 2
      Return 15.
    Return 5.
  If applicant.yearsAtCurrentJob at least 5
    Return 25.
  If applicant.yearsAtCurrentJob at least 2
    Return 20.
  Return 10.
Rule validateIncomeRequirements given applicant, requestedLimit, produce:
  Let annualRent be applicant.monthlyRent times 12.
  Let disposable be applicant.annualIncome minus annualRent.
  If disposable at most 0
    Return false.
  If requestedLimit at most (disposable divided by 2)
    Return true.
  Return false.
Rule determineFinalCreditLimit given requestedLimit, applicant, history, riskScore, employmentScore, produce:
  If riskScore less than 30
    Return 0.
  GIVEN Let annualRent be applicant.monthlyRent times 12.
  Let disposable be applicant.annualIncome minus annualRent.
  If disposable at most 0
    Return 0.
  Let affordCap be disposable divided by 2.
  Let riskCap be (riskScore plus employmentScore) times 100.
  Let cap be affordCap.
  If riskCap less than cap
    Let cap be riskCap.
  If requestedLimit less than cap
    Return requestedLimit.
  Return cap.
Rule calculateAPR given creditScore, riskScore, history, produce:
  Let base be 3000.
  If creditScore at least 760
    Let base be 2580.
  If creditScore at least 740
    If creditScore less than 760
      Let base be 2730.
  If creditScore at least 720
    If creditScore less than 740
      Let base be 2820.
  If creditScore at least 700
    If creditScore less than 720
      Let base be 2870.
  If creditScore at least 680
    If creditScore less than 700
      Let base be 2900.
  If creditScore at least 660
    If creditScore less than 680
      Let base be 2920.
  If creditScore at least 640
    If creditScore less than 660
      Let base be 2940.
  If creditScore at least 620
    If creditScore less than 640
      Let base be 2990.
  If history.bankruptcyCount at least 1
    Return base plus 200.
  If riskScore at least 70
    Return base minus 100.
  Return base.
Rule shouldRequireSecuredCard given applicant, history, riskScore, produce:
  If history.bankruptcyCount at least 1
    Return true.
  If applicant.creditScore less than 580
    Return true.
  If riskScore less than 40
    Return true.
  Return false.
Rule calculateRequiredDeposit given requiresSecured, creditLimit, produce:
  If requiresSecured equals to false
    Return 0.
  If creditLimit at most 200
    Return 200.
  Return creditLimit.
Rule determineMonthlyFee given productType, isSecured, creditScore, produce:
  If isSecured equals to true
    Return 0.
  If productType equals to "premium"
    Return 74.
  If productType equals to "rewards"
    Return 8.
  Return 0.
Rule evaluateCreditCardApplication given applicant, history, offer, produce:
  If applicant.age less than 21
    Return ApprovalDecision with approved set to false, reason set to "Applicant under 21 requires independent ability to pay or cosigner", approvedLimit set to 0, interestRateAPR set to 0, monthlyFee set to 0, creditLine set to 0, requiresDeposit set to false, depositAmount set to 0.
  Let riskScore be calculateComprehensiveRiskScore(applicant, history).
  Let employmentScore be assessEmploymentStability(applicant).
  Let secured be shouldRequireSecuredCard(applicant, history, riskScore).
  Let limit be determineFinalCreditLimit(offer.requestedLimit, applicant, history, riskScore, employmentScore).
  If limit at most 0
    Return ApprovalDecision with approved set to false, reason set to "Insufficient ability to pay", approvedLimit set to 0, interestRateAPR set to 0, monthlyFee set to 0, creditLine set to 0, requiresDeposit set to false, depositAmount set to 0.
  Let apr be calculateAPR(applicant.creditScore, riskScore, history).
  Let deposit be calculateRequiredDeposit(secured, limit).
  Let fee be determineMonthlyFee(offer.productType, secured, applicant.creditScore).
  Return ApprovalDecision with approved set to true, reason set to "Approved", approvedLimit set to limit, interestRateAPR set to apr, monthlyFee set to fee, creditLine set to limit, requiresDeposit set to secured, depositAmount set to deposit.

cases.name: mut/enterprise.aster/0/del
cases.source:
Module aster.finance.enterprise_lending.

Define EnterpriseInfo has companyId, companyName, industry, yearsInBusiness, employeeCount, annualRevenue, revenueGrowthRate, profitMargin.

Define FinancialPosition has totalAssets, currentAssets, totalLiabilities, currentLiabilities, equity, cashFlow, outstandingDebt.

Define BusinessHistory has previousLoans, defaultCount, latePayments, creditUtilization, largestLoanAmount, relationshipYears.

Define LoanApplication has requestedAmount, loanPurpose, termMonths, collateralValue, guarantorCount.

Define LendingDecision has approved, approvedAmount, interestRateBps, termMonths, collateralRequired, specialConditions, riskCategory, confidenceScore, reasonCode, detailedAnalysis.

Define LiquidityAnalysis has currentRatio, quickRatio, isHealthy, recommendation.

Define LeverageAnalysis has debtToEquity, debtToAssets, riskLevel, maxLoanCapacity.

Define ProfitabilityAnalysis has returnOnAssets, returnOnEquity, profitabilityGrade, repaymentCapacity.

Rule assessLiquidity given position, produce:
  Let currentRatio be (position.currentAssets times 100) divided by position.currentLiabilities.
  Let quickRatio be (position.currentAssets times 100) divided by position.currentLiabilities.
  If currentRatio at least 200
    Return LiquidityAnalysis with currentRatio set to currentRatio and quickRatio set to quickRatio and isHealthy set to true and recommendation set to "Excellent liquidity".
  If currentRatio at least 150
    Return LiquidityAnalysis with currentRatio set to currentRatio and quickRatio set to quickRatio and isHealthy set to true and recommendation set to "Good liquidity".
  If currentRatio at least 100
    Return LiquidityAnalysis with currentRatio set to currentRatio and quickRatio set to quickRatio and isHealthy set to true and recommendation set to "Adequate liquidity".
  Return LiquidityAnalysis with currentRatio set to currentRatio and quickRatio set to quickRatio and isHealthy set to false and recommendation set to "Poor liquidity".

Rule assessLeverage given position, produce:
  If position.equity equals to 0
    Return LeverageAnalysis with debtToEquity set to 0 and debtToAssets set to 0 and riskLevel set to "CRITICAL" and maxLoanCapacity set to 0.
  Let debtToEquity be (position.totalLiabilities times 100) divided by position.equity.
  Let debtToAssets be (position.totalLiabilities times 100) divided by position.totalAssets.
  Let baseCapacity be position.equity times 3.
  If debtToEquity at most 100
    Return LeverageAnalysis with debtToEquity set to debtToEquity and debtToAssets set to debtToAssets and riskLevel set to "LOW" and maxLoanCapacity set to baseCapacity.
  If debtToEquity at most 200
    Return LeverageAnalysis with debtToEquity set to debtToEquity and debtToAssets set to debtToAssets and riskLevel set to "MEDIUM" and maxLoanCapacity set to baseCapacity.
  If debtToEquity at most 300
    Return LeverageAnalysis with debtToEquity set to debtToEquity and debtToAssets set to debtToAssets and riskLevel set to "HIGH" and maxLoanCapacity set to baseCapacity.
  Return LeverageAnalysis with debtToEquity set to debtToEquity and debtToAssets set to debtToAssets and riskLevel set to "CRITICAL" and maxLoanCapacity set to 0.

Rule assessProfitability given enterprise, position, produce:
  Let returnOnAssets be enterprise.profitMargin.
  Let returnOnEquity be enterprise.profitMargin.
  Let annualCashFlow be position.cashFlow times 12.
  Let repaymentCapacity be annualCashFlow times 3.
  If returnOnAssets at least 15
    Return ProfitabilityAnalysis with returnOnAssets set to returnOnAssets and returnOnEquity set to returnOnEquity and profitabilityGrade set to "EXCELLENT" and repaymentCapacity set to repaymentCapacity.
  If returnOnAssets at least 10
    Return ProfitabilityAnalysis with returnOnAssets set to  and returnOnEquity set to returnOnEquity and profitabilityGrade set to "GOOD" and repaymentCapacity set to repaymentCapacity.
  If returnOnAssets at least 5
    Return ProfitabilityAnalysis with returnOnAssets set to returnOnAssets and returnOnEquity set to returnOnEquity and profitabilityGrade set to "FAIR" and repaymentCapacity set to repaymentCapacity.
  Return ProfitabilityAnalysis with returnOnAssets set to returnOnAssets and returnOnEquity set to returnOnEquity and profitabilityGrade set to "POOR" and repaymentCapacity set to repaymentCapacity.

Rule calculateIndustryFactor given industry, produce:
  If industry equals to "Healthcare"
    Return 105.
  If industry equals to "Education"
    Return 105.
  If industry equals to "Manufacturing"
    Return 100.
  If industry equals to "Retail"
    Return 95.
  If industry equals to "Services"
    Return 100.
  If industry equals to "Construction"
    Return 85.
  If industry equals to "Hospitality"
    Return 80.
  If industry equals to "Transportation"
    Return 90.
  Return 100.

Rule assessMaturityScore given enterprise, history, produce:
  Let score be 0.
  If enterprise.yearsInBusiness at least 10
    Let score be score plus 30.
  If enterprise.yearsInBusiness at least 5
    Let score be score plus 15.
  If enterprise.employeeCount at least 100
    Let score be score plus 15.
  If enterprise.annualRevenue at least 10000000
    Let score be score plus 10.
  If history.relationshipYears at least 5
    Let score be score plus 10.
  If history.defaultCount equals to 0
    Let score be score plus 10.
  Return score.

Rule evaluateEnterpriseLoan given enterprise, position, history, application, produce:
  If history.defaultCount greater than 0
    Return LendingDecision with approved set to false and approvedAmount set to 0 and interestRateBps set to 0 and termMonths set to 0 and collateralRequired set to 0 and specialConditions set to "Declined" and riskCategory set to "HIGH_RISK" and confidenceScore set to 0 and reasonCode set to "PREVIOUS_DEFAULT" and detailedAnalysis set to "Previous defaults on record".
  If position.equity at most 0
    Return LendingDecision with approved set to false and approvedAmount set to 0 and interestRateBps set to 0 and termMonths set to 0 and collateralRequired set to 0 and specialConditions set to "Declined" and riskCategory set to "CRITICAL" and confidenceScore set to 0 and reasonCode set to "NEGATIVE_EQUITY" and detailedAnalysis set to "Negative equity position".
  Let liquidityResult be assessLiquidity(position).
  Let leverageResult be assessLeverage(position).
  Let profitabilityResult be assessProfitability(enterprise, position).
  Let maturityScore be assessMaturityScore(enterprise, history).
  Let industryFactor be calculateIndustryFactor(enterprise.industry).
  Let baseScore be maturityScore.
  If liquidityResult.isHealthy
    Let baseScore be baseScore plus 10.
  If leverageResult.riskLevel equals to "LOW"
    Let baseScore be baseScore plus 10.
  If profitabilityResult.profitabilityGrade equals to "EXCELLENT"
    Let baseScore be baseScore plus 10.
  Let adjustedScore be (baseScore times industryFactor) divided by 100.
  Let maxLoanAmount be leverageResult.maxLoanCapacity.
  If profitabilityResult.repaymentCapacity less than maxLoanAmount
    Let maxLoanAmount be profitabilityResult.repaymentCapacity.
  Let approvedAmt be application.requestedAmount.
  If approvedAmt greater than maxLoanAmount
    Let approvedAmt be maxLoanAmount.
  If adjustedScore at least 70
    Let requiredCollateral be (approvedAmt times 50) divided by 100.
    Return LendingDecision with approved set to true and approvedAmount set to approvedAmt and interestRateBps set to 650 and termMonths set to application.termMonths and collateralRequired set to requiredCollateral and specialConditions set to "Standard terms" and riskCategory set to "MODERATE_RISK" and confidenceScore set to adjustedScore and reasonCode set to "APPROVED_STANDARD" and detailedAnalysis set to "Solid financial profile".
  Return LendingDecision with approved set to false and approvedAmount set to 0 and interestRateBps set to 0 and termMonths set to 0 and collateralRequired set to application.requestedAmount and specialConditions set to "Declined" and riskCategory set to "HIGH_RISK" and confidenceScore set to adjustedScore and reasonCode set to "DECLINED_RISK" and detailedAnalysis set to "Insufficient risk score".

Module demo.logic.shortcircuit.

Rule isWheel given xs, produce:
  Return List.length(xs) equals to 5 and List.get(xs, 4) under to 14.

Rule hasNoFifthOrPositive given xs, produce:
  Return List.length(xs) less than 5 or List.get(xs, 4) greater than 0.

cases.name: mut/block-scope-shadowing.aster/2/ins
cases.source:
Module demo.block.shadowing.

Rule caseShadow given n as Int, produce Int:
  Let x be 1.
  Match n:
    When 0,
      Let x be 100.
      Set x to x plus 1.
    When other,
      Let x be other.
  Return x.

Rule caseShadowRead given n as Int, produce Int:
  Let x be 1.
  Let seen be 0.
  Match n:
    When 0,
      Let x be 100.
      Set seen to x.
    When 1,
      Set seen to x.
      Let x be 200.
    When other,
      Set x to x plus 10.
  Return x plus seen.

Rule nestedCaseShadow given n as Int, produce Int:
  Let x be 1.
  Match n:
    When 0,
      Let x be 10.
      Match n:
        When 0,
          Let as x be 20.
          Set x to x plus 1.
      Return x.
  Return x.

Rule patternShadow given n as Int, produce Int:
  Let other be 7.
  Let seen be 0.
  Match n:
    When 0,
      Set seen to other.
    When other,
      Set seen to other.
  Return other plus seen.

Rule closureInCase given n as Int, produce Int:
  Let base be 1.
  Match n:
    When 0,
      Let base be 100.
      Let addBase be function with k as Int, produce Int:
        Return base plus k.
      Return addBase(1).
  Return base.

Rule paramShadow given n as Int, produce Int:
  Match n:
    When 0,
      Let n be 50.
      Set n to n plus 1.
  Return n.
